title: GraphNode
description: A node in the Graph Runtime (RUN-002). Recursive: sequential/parallel/fan_in/conditional/loop/subgraph nodes contain child GraphNodes via 'children'/'if_true'/'if_false'/'body'/'graph'; tool_call is the only leaf kind. Evaluated by aeon_worker.graph.execute_graph inside a Temporal workflow (docs/adr/0001) — never call a model or tool outside this executor's Activity calls.

id.description: Unique within the graph; used as the idempotency key's node_id component for tool_call leaves and as the key into the run's node-result context for conditional/loop references.

children.description: kind=sequential (run in order) | parallel (run concurrently) | fan_in (run concurrently, then merge each child's 'result' field into a single list).

condition.description: kind=conditional only. { node_ref: <id already executed>, path: dotted path into that node's result, equals|exists: comparator }.

if_false.description: kind=conditional only; optional — if omitted and the condition is false, the conditional node is a no-op.

body.description: kind=loop only. Re-executed up to max_iterations times; each iteration's node id is '<body.id>[<iteration index>]', which keeps idempotency keys distinct per iteration.

max_iterations.description: kind=loop only. Hard bound — the loop runtime does not support unbounded loops (a taste of RUN-003's hard budgets, ahead of the full budget system).

stop_condition.description: kind=loop only, optional. { path: dotted path into the just-completed iteration's result, equals|exists: comparator }. When it matches after an iteration, the loop stops early with stopped_reason='condition_met' instead of running to max_iterations.

graph.description: kind=subgraph only. Executed recursively via the same executor; the result is { node_id, kind: 'subgraph', graph_result: <inner graph's result> } — wrapped, not transparent, so the subgraph node's own id stays findable in the result tree.
